evidence.detail: Exact v308 extends JLabel, owns two static Border values, one final JComponent content, a BooleanSupplier on-select hook and selected boolean, with String/ImageIcon constructors tied to rs/ui/components/b/e.

Its select path runs the BooleanSupplier veto, applies selected border/white foreground and flips selected=true; unselect applies the unselected border/gray foreground. Constructors install the same group-selection and hover listeners as RuneLite MaterialTab.

RuneLite upstream 6e74752caa80fe9cb96cd9b37207e171fa525f07 net.runelite.client.ui.components.materialtabs.MaterialTab has the same fields, constructors, select/unselect behavior, borders and hover/group listener structure.

proposals.note: MaterialTab is an exact upstream source-name recovery at confidence 0.999; anonymous MouseAdapter helper classes remain intentionally unnamed.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 extends JPanel, owns one final display JPanel and one List<rs/ui/components/b/a>, with display and no-arg constructors, indexed tab lookup, add-tab and select-tab methods.
